cohort: 1,347 pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 positive results
finding: While a high rate of operative delivery was observed in pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2, especially in those with IVF pregnancies, method of conception did not affect fetal or maternal outcomes, except for a higher rate of preeclampsia in the IVF group.
mod_finding: A high rate of operative delivery was observed in pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2, especially in those with IVF pregnancies, where cesarean section became the most frequent method of delivery (55.4%, compared with 26.1% of the spontaneous pregnancy group).
